query: db.matches.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "season": 1 }, output: { moving_avg: { $avg: "$possession", window: { documents: [-2, 0] } } } } }, { $match: { $expr: { $gt: ["$possession", { $multiply: ["$moving_avg", 1.25] }] } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, team: 1, possession: "$possession", moving_avg: 1 } }])
